name: scrolly-maplibre
description: Config-driven scrollytelling maps with MapLibre GL JS and Scrollama.

scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o dist/styles/styles.min.css dist/styles/styles.css && cleancss -o dist/styles/loader.min.css dist/styles/loader.css
scripts.patch:html: replace-in-file "js/core/init.js" "js/bundle.min.js" dist/index.html && replace-in-file "<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles/styles.css\">" "<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles/styles.min.css\">" dist/index.html && replace-in-file "<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles/loader.css\">" "<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"styles/loader.min.css\">" dist/index.html && replace-in-file "<link rel=\"preload\" href=\"styles/styles.css\"" "<link rel=\"preload\" href=\"styles/styles.min.css\"" dist/index.html && replace-in-file "<link rel=\"preload\" href=\"styles/loader.css\"" "<link rel=\"preload\" href=\"styles/loader.min.css\"" dist/index.html && replace-in-file "type=\"module\"" "" dist/index.html
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy-html && npm run copy-css && npm run copy:config && npm run copy:assets && npm run bundle:js && npm run minify:js && npm run minify:css && npm run patch:html && npm run minify:html && npm run cleanup
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run preview

author: Jesse Friend
